title: Medical office, patient in a wheelchair, oxygen on site

lines.text: 911, what is the address of your emergency?
6550 Mapleridge Street, the Bellaire medical building. There's smoke in the hallway in the back, it's filling up fast!
One of our patients is still inside, she uses a wheelchair. She was in an exam room near the storage closets.
Any hazards we should know about?
We keep oxygen tanks in the storage closet.
I'm in the parking lot out front.
